In [[Seven-dimensional space|seven-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''quarter 7-cubic honeycomb''' is a uniform space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]). It has half the vertices of the [[7-demicubic honeycomb]], and a quarter of the vertices of a [[7-cube honeycomb]].<ref>Coxeter, '''Regular and Semi-Regular Polytopes III''', (1988), p318</ref> Its facets are [[7-demicube]]s, [[pentellated 7-demicube]]s, and {3<sup>1,1,1</sup>}×{3,3} [[duoprism]]s.
